protocol.scope: Major revision; original inputs and manuscript are read-only. All new outputs are kept in this directory.
protocol.selection_loss: pooled inner-validation mean squared error; no outer-test outcome is used for selection
protocol.window_rule: Reference-coordinate windows: subdivide original at-most-25-SNP/50kb windows for scales 5/10, retain for 25, merge two/four consecutive same-chromosome windows for 50/100. Boundaries are outcome-independent. Mean dosage weights all retained SNPs equally within each window.
protocol.fair_ablation: Use exactly the legacy 202747 marker indices and 83-accession allele indicators for SNP, regional linear and local Gaussian models; fixed reference window 25. Match the legacy folds and hyperparameter choices where reproducing old numbers, and distinguish this ablation from fully inductive evaluation.
protocol.strict_preprocessing: Every inner/outer training split estimates the allele convention, retains biallelic polymorphic markers with training MAF>0.05, and estimates feature scales. SNP/linear/local kernels all use the same retained indicators. Constant regional features are removed by training-only checks. Centering and trace normalization use only training kernels and are frozen for the cross kernel.
protocol.additional_comparisons: Strong baselines and sensitivity analyses are not selected post hoc according to significance.
metrics: calibration slope: observed regressed on predictions
protocol.uncertainty: Repeat metrics describe split variability, not independent biological replications. Report paired differences and conditional accession/ancestry-cluster bootstrap intervals with explicit limitations; retain Nadeau-Bengio only as approximate sensitivity. Add a training-refitted robustness analysis rather than treating saved predictions as covering training-set uncertainty. Phenotype signal tests are distinct from model-superiority tests.
protocol.external_policy: Freeze all model selection using the training cohort only. Audit overlaps by canonical genotype column/ecotype ID, not names alone. Do not optimize models on external outcomes.
protocol.robustness: Retain all accessions in the main analysis. Prespecified sensitivity leaves out the single maximum-DSDS50 accession and reports its identity; do not search for favorable exclusions.
protocol.disclosure: This protocol was set for the revision after reading reviewer comments; it is not prospectively registered before the original study. Report all completed outcomes irrespective of direction.

preprocessing: Each inner/outer TRAIN only: original codes 0..3; exactly two occurring allele classes; min nonzero allele count / n > .05; lowest code breaks a count tie; indicator 0/1, not diploid dosage. Mean=f, sd=sqrt(f(1-f)) estimated only on train. Novel query allele codes map to 0 under frozen train indicator.

ld.pruning: Coordinate-ordered greedy; retain j iff no previously retained same-chromosome marker <=100kb has Pearson r^2 > .2. No stride/subsampling or old 9245-marker list.
ld.old_implementation_error: scripts/02_qc_population_structure.py:68 compares max(abs(r)) < r2_thr, so .2 is |r|, i.e. r^2 < .04, not the intended .2.
ld.score: ell_j = 1 + sum_{k != j, same chromosome, |pos_j-pos_k|<=100000} r_jk^2 on all train-QC markers; self term 1.
ld.weighted_kernel: K = sum_j (1/ell_j) z_j z_j' / sum_j (1/ell_j), z=(indicator-f)/sqrt(f(1-f)); then train-only centered trace normalization.
ld.maf_weights: No extra MAF exponent (exponent 0 for standardized features). On unstandardized centered indicators the weight is 1/[f_j(1-f_j)*ell_j]. MAF cutoff, minor coding, variance and LD scores are fold-train estimates, all arrays saved.
ld.limitations: Local inverse-LD-score linear kernel, NOT exact LDAK. No LDAK iterative redundancy weights, recombination model, genome-wide correction or claimed LDAK heritability parameterization; sample LD is noisy at n~53-67.

bayesc.model: BayesC fixed-pi point-mass + common normal slab; pi defined as inclusion probability.
bayesc.selection: pooled nested inner MSE of two-chain posterior mean predictions
bayesc.equations: y* = mu + sum_j z_j b_j + e; e~N(0,sigma_e2 I); b_j~(1-pi)delta_0+pi*N(0,tau2); mu~flat; sigma_e2~IG(3,1); tau2~IG(3,1/(p*pi)); prior h2=.5, y* train standardized. v=(z'z/sigma_e2+1/tau2)^-1; m=v*z'r/sigma_e2; logBF=.5*(log(v/tau2)+m^2/v). Bernoulli inclusion odds=pi/(1-pi)*BF. sigma_e2|.~IG(3+n/2,1+RSS/2); tau2|.~IG(3+k/2,1/(p*pi)+sum_nonzero b^2/2).
bayesc.mixing_step: Coordinate Gibbs plus exact joint scale Metropolis-within-Gibbs: log c~N(0,.15^2), b'=c*b, tau2'=c^2*tau2, same indicators. log acceptance = -(RSS'-RSS)/(2*sigma_e2) -2*a_b*log c + b_b/tau2*(1-c^-2); Jacobian c^(k+2). Same posterior, no tempering. Independently seeded prior-variance initialization, residual recomputation every 50 sweeps; acceptance and numerical residual drift saved.
bayesc.diagnostics: rank-normalized/folded split Rhat<=1.1, approximate Geyer bulk ESS>=100, all query predictions and 3 global parameters; failures retained/flagged, never silently declared converged.
bayesc.limitations: Shared slab variance and fixed .5 prior h2; pi is tuned but variance prior is not. Finite MCMC, no diagnostic for every SNP effect; correlated-marker mixing can fail. Not BayesianRidge and not BayesCpi with a sampled pi.

random_forest.other: bootstrap=True, squared_error, unbounded depth, n_jobs=2; same split-pruned SNPs; no supervised SNP screening.

dog1.model: (1-w) K_all_train_QC_SNP + w K_DOG1; both centered/trace-normalized on train. w and lambda pooled-inner tuned. Empty DOG1 gives zero regional kernel.
dog1.selection: Fixed TAIR10 annotation gene plus 50kb flanks, not full-83-y GWAS or a selected association peak.

cv.selection: pooled squared error / number of outer training accessions

metrics_policy: Only new strict OOF predictions. Separate smoke subtree; no old reported metrics imported. Repeat SD is split variability, not independent replications.
